name: Commercial Spaces
title: Music-Reactive Lighting for Commercial Spaces in Ontario
metaDescription: Permanent music-reactive pixel lighting for retail plazas, restaurants, patios, venues and property managers across Ontario. Design, supply, installation and seasonal service. Request a quote.
h1: Commercial lighting that reacts to the room.
intro: Restaurants, patios, retail plazas, venues and managed properties use Resonate kits to turn an ordinary frontage into the reason people stop, look and come in. The display listens to your music and moves with it — every night, without staff touching anything.

sections.heading: Why commercial operators choose pixel lighting
sections.body: Traditional string lights are static and seasonal. Addressable 12 V WS2811 pixels give you every colour, every pattern, and the ability to change the whole look from a phone. A patio can run a slow warm Pulse on a Tuesday and a full Rainbow Scroll for a Saturday event — same hardware, no ladders.

sections.heading: Built to run itself
sections.body: The kit boots into the Resonate Light Show app automatically. Staff connect to the controller's own Wi-Fi hotspot from any phone — no app store, no accounts — and pick a mode and colour theme. Scheduling turns the show on at dusk and off at close.

sections.heading: Permanent or seasonal
sections.body: Roofline runs and accent strips are designed to stay up year-round and change theme with the calendar. Mega trees and singing trees can be permanent features or seasonal installs with takedown and storage handled by our team.

faqs.question: Does the lighting need our sound system?
faqs.answer: No. A USB microphone on the controller listens to ambient music, so any speaker system works. If you prefer, we can place the mic near a speaker for tighter response.

faqs.question: Can we turn the reactivity off?
faqs.answer: Yes. Solid, Rainbow and Scroll modes can run without music, and you can set a fixed colour theme for quiet hours.

faqs.question: What about winter?
faqs.answer: Props use 12 V WS2811 pixels in weather-rated housings with sealed power connections. We design for Ontario snow and wind loads.

name: Business Improvement Areas
title: BIA Streetscape & Holiday Lighting | Ontario Pixel Light Shows
metaDescription: Synchronized pixel lighting for Business Improvement Areas: mega trees, singing trees and roofline runs across multiple buildings, with lifetime control software. Ontario BIA lighting quotes.
h1: Give your main street a show worth the drive.
intro: Business Improvement Areas compete for foot traffic with malls and online shopping. A synchronized light show along the main street — rooflines across several buildings, a mega tree in the square, singing trees for the holiday program — creates an event people plan around and merchants benefit from.

sections.heading: One show across many buildings
sections.body: Kulp K-series controllers running FPP synchronize props spread along a street into a single timed show. Sequenced holiday programs run on a schedule; live-reactive zones (powered by the Pi 5 and LedFx) respond to buskers, parades and street performers.

sections.heading: Designed around your budget cycle
sections.body: We scope BIA projects in phases — a central mega tree and a few rooflines in year one, expanding block by block. Every phase uses the same control platform, so nothing is thrown away as the display grows.

sections.heading: Serviced for the season
sections.body: Our seasonal service covers show sequencing, theme changeovers, pixel checks and, where props are seasonal, takedown and storage. Your coordinator gets the Light Show app for day-to-day control.

faqs.question: Who controls the display?
faqs.answer: Your BIA coordinator (or delegate) uses the Resonate Light Show app from any phone connected to the controller's hotspot. Scheduled shows run automatically on FPP.

faqs.question: Can merchants have their own zones?
faqs.answer: Yes. Rooflines can be grouped so individual storefronts run their own theme while still joining the main sequenced show at set times.

faqs.question: Do you work with municipal electrical?
faqs.answer: Yes. We design power distribution around available circuits and coordinate with your municipality's electrical contractor where required.

name: Municipalities
title: Municipal Holiday & Public Space Lighting | Ontario Pixel Light Shows
metaDescription: Public-space pixel lighting for Ontario municipalities: mega trees, singing trees and streetscape runs with scheduled sequenced shows. Design, supply, installation and seasonal service. Request a quote.
h1: Public light shows, built for public spaces.
intro: Town squares, parks, waterfronts and civic buildings are where a community gathers in winter. Resonate municipal kits put a synchronized mega tree and singing-tree program at the centre of it, with the durability, lockable enclosures and scheduling municipalities require.

sections.heading: Scheduled, sequenced, dependable
sections.body: Municipal shows run on Kulp K-series controllers with FPP, playing sequenced holiday programs on a schedule you set. Live-reactive zones driven by the Pi 5 controller and USB microphone can be added for tree-lighting ceremonies and events.

sections.heading: Hardware chosen for public sites
sections.body: 12 V WS2811 pixels in weather-rated housings, sealed power injection, and lockable enclosures for controllers and supplies. Props are anchored for snow and wind loads and placed with sightlines and pedestrian safety in mind.

sections.heading: Procurement-friendly scoping
sections.body: We provide itemized scopes with product descriptions, power requirements and service terms suitable for council reports and procurement processes. Pricing is quoted per project in Canadian dollars.

faqs.question: Can the show be timed to a tree-lighting ceremony?
faqs.answer: Yes. A sequenced FPP show can be triggered manually at the ceremony, then revert to the nightly schedule.

faqs.question: How are updates handled?
faqs.answer: Software updates for the Resonate Light Show app are included for the life of the kit and are applied during service visits or remotely where network access is available.

faqs.question: Do you provide documentation?
faqs.answer: Yes. Each project is delivered with a prop map, power plan, controller configuration and a one-page operator guide.
